CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.activate_truck_spares_on_close()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_item record;
  v_key text;
  v_asset public.asset_inventory%rowtype;
begin
  if new.status<>'closed'::public.prep_status or old.status='closed'::public.prep_status then return new; end if;

  if exists(
    select 1 from public.prep_items
    where prep_ticket_id=new.id
      and purpose='BACKUP'::public.prep_purpose
      and spare_it_checked_out_at is null
  ) then
    raise exception 'Service cannot take a truck spare that IT did not check out';
  end if;

  if exists(
    select 1 from public.truck_spare_batteries
    where prep_ticket_id=new.id
      and status='prepared'
      and it_checked_out_at is null
  ) then
    raise exception 'Service cannot take spare batteries that IT did not check out';
  end if;

  update public.truck_spare_batteries
  set service_tech_id=new.closed_by,
      service_tech_name=new.closed_by_name,
      status='in_truck',
      accepted_at=now(),
      updated_at=now()
  where prep_ticket_id=new.id
    and status='prepared'
    and it_checked_out_at is not null;

  update public.prep_items
  set spare_checked_out_at=now(),
      spare_checked_out_to=new.closed_by,
      spare_checked_out_to_name=new.closed_by_name
  where prep_ticket_id=new.id
    and purpose='BACKUP'::public.prep_purpose
    and spare_it_checked_out_at is not null
    and spare_checked_out_at is null;

  for v_item in
    select id,unit_tag,equipment_type
    from public.prep_items
    where prep_ticket_id=new.id
      and purpose='BACKUP'::public.prep_purpose
      and spare_it_checked_out_at is not null
  loop
    v_key:=public.normalize_unit_key(v_item.unit_tag);

    update public.unit_registry
    set lifecycle_status='deployed',
        current_holder_id=new.closed_by,
        current_holder_name=new.closed_by_name,
        last_event='IT checkout accepted by Service Tech '||coalesce(new.closed_by_name,'Service Tech')||
          ' for truck spare on MHelpDesk #'||new.ticket_no,
        updated_at=now()
    where unit_key=v_key;

    select * into v_asset
    from public.asset_inventory
    where unit_key=v_key
    for update;

    if found then
      insert into public.asset_inventory_history(
        unit_key,unit_tag,action,from_status,to_status,
        from_user_id,from_user_name,to_user_id,to_user_name,
        actor_id,actor_name,notes
      ) values(
        v_asset.unit_key,v_asset.unit_tag,'service_accepts_it_spare_checkout',
        v_asset.availability_status,'assigned',
        v_asset.assigned_to,v_asset.assigned_to_name,
        new.closed_by,new.closed_by_name,
        new.closed_by,new.closed_by_name,
        'Service accepted IT-checked-out truck spare for MHelpDesk #'||new.ticket_no
      );

      update public.asset_inventory
      set availability_status='assigned',
          assigned_to=new.closed_by,
          assigned_to_name=new.closed_by_name,
          last_event='Service accepted IT truck spare checkout for MHelpDesk #'||new.ticket_no,
          updated_at=now()
      where unit_key=v_key;
    end if;
  end loop;

  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.close_stale_service_truck_restock_requests_v1()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
 update public.service_truck_restock_requests r
 set status='cancelled',updated_at=now()
 where r.status in ('requested','preparing','ready','issued') and (
  (r.item_kind='unit' and exists(select 1 from public.service_truck_units u where u.service_tech_id=r.service_tech_id and u.equipment_type=r.item_type and u.status='assigned' and nullif(trim(u.unit_tag),'') is not null))
  or (r.item_kind='sim' and exists(select 1 from public.service_truck_sims s where s.service_tech_id=r.service_tech_id and s.slot_no=r.sim_slot_no and s.status='assigned' and nullif(trim(s.sim_number),'') is not null))
  or (r.item_kind='battery' and exists(
    select 1 from public.service_truck_stock s where s.service_tech_id=r.service_tech_id and (
      (r.item_type='Recon Battery' and s.recon_battery_qty>=25) or
      (r.item_type='AGM 12V 110Ah' and s.agm_12v_110ah_qty>=4) or
      (r.item_type='LiTime 12V 100Ah' and s.litime_12v_100ah_qty>=2) or
      (r.item_type='12V 35Ah' and s.battery_12v_35ah_qty>=4)
    )
  ))
 );
end

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.owner_restore_workflow_checkpoint(p_checkpoint_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare c public.workflow_checkpoints%rowtype; v_name text;
begin
  perform public.require_role(array['owner'::public.app_role]);
  select * into c from public.workflow_checkpoints where id=p_checkpoint_id;
  if not found then raise exception 'Checkpoint not found'; end if;
  select coalesce(full_name,username,email,'Owner') into v_name from public.profiles where user_id=auth.uid();

  if c.source_table='job_assignments' then
    if c.before_data is null then
      update public.job_assignments set status='cancelled',cancelled_at=now(),updated_at=now() where id=c.record_id;
    else
      update public.job_assignments set
        status=coalesce(c.before_data->>'status',status),
        prep_ticket_id=nullif(c.before_data->>'prep_ticket_id','')::uuid,
        assignee_user_id=nullif(c.before_data->>'assignee_user_id','')::uuid,
        assignee_name=coalesce(c.before_data->>'assignee_name',assignee_name),
        assignment_scope=coalesce(c.before_data->>'assignment_scope',assignment_scope),
        started_at=nullif(c.before_data->>'started_at','')::timestamptz,
        completed_at=nullif(c.before_data->>'completed_at','')::timestamptz,
        cancelled_at=nullif(c.before_data->>'cancelled_at','')::timestamptz,
        claimed_at=nullif(c.before_data->>'claimed_at','')::timestamptz,
        updated_at=now()
      where id=c.record_id;
    end if;
  elsif c.source_table='prep_tickets' then
    if c.before_data is not null then
      update public.prep_tickets set
        status=(c.before_data->>'status')::public.prep_status,
        released_at=nullif(c.before_data->>'released_at','')::timestamptz,
        released_by=nullif(c.before_data->>'released_by','')::uuid,
        released_by_name=c.before_data->>'released_by_name',
        closed_at=nullif(c.before_data->>'closed_at','')::timestamptz,
        closed_by=nullif(c.before_data->>'closed_by','')::uuid,
        closed_by_name=c.before_data->>'closed_by_name',
        service_parts_confirmed=coalesce((c.before_data->>'service_parts_confirmed')::boolean,false),
        service_parts_confirmed_by=nullif(c.before_data->>'service_parts_confirmed_by','')::uuid,
        service_parts_confirmed_by_name=c.before_data->>'service_parts_confirmed_by_name',
        service_parts_confirmed_at=nullif(c.before_data->>'service_parts_confirmed_at','')::timestamptz
      where id=c.record_id;
    else
      update public.prep_tickets set status='draft',released_at=null,released_by=null,released_by_name=null,closed_at=null,closed_by=null,closed_by_name=null where id=c.record_id;
    end if;
  elsif c.source_table='unit_returns' then
    if c.before_data is null then
      delete from public.unit_returns where id=c.record_id;
    else
      update public.unit_returns set
        status=coalesce(c.before_data->>'status',status),
        it_tech_id=nullif(c.before_data->>'it_tech_id','')::uuid,
        it_tech_name=c.before_data->>'it_tech_name',
        it_received_at=nullif(c.before_data->>'it_received_at','')::timestamptz,
        damage_notes=c.before_data->>'damage_notes',
        intake_photo_paths=coalesce(array(select jsonb_array_elements_text(coalesce(c.before_data->'intake_photo_paths','[]'::jsonb))),'{}'::text[]),
        mhelp_inventory_confirmed=coalesce((c.before_data->>'mhelp_inventory_confirmed')::boolean,false),
        mhelp_confirmed_at=nullif(c.before_data->>'mhelp_confirmed_at','')::timestamptz,
        completed_at=nullif(c.before_data->>'completed_at','')::timestamptz,
        updated_at=now()
      where id=c.record_id;
    end if;
  end if;

  update public.workflow_checkpoints set restored_at=now(),restored_by=auth.uid(),restored_by_name=coalesce(v_name,'Owner') where id=c.id;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.owner_test_ensure_assignment_v1(p_ticket_no text, p_role text, p_test_tech_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_owner public.profiles%rowtype;
  v_tech public.profiles%rowtype;
  v_prep public.prep_tickets%rowtype;
  v_assignment public.job_assignments%rowtype;
  v_manifest jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  v_count int := 0;
  v_work_type text;
begin
  select * into v_owner
  from public.profiles
  where user_id=auth.uid()
    and active=true
    and archived_at is null
    and role::text='owner';
  if not found then raise exception 'Owner/Admin access required.'; end if;

  if p_role not in ('it','service') then
    raise exception 'IT or Service test role required.';
  end if;

  select * into v_tech
  from public.profiles
  where user_id=p_test_tech_id
    and active=true
    and archived_at is null
    and role::text=p_role;
  if not found then
    raise exception 'Active % test technician required.', upper(p_role);
  end if;

  select * into v_prep
  from public.prep_tickets
  where trim(ticket_no)=trim(p_ticket_no)
    and is_test=true
  order by created_at desc
  limit 1;
  if not found then raise exception 'Owner Test Center ticket not found.'; end if;

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'equipment_type',x.equipment_type,
      'purpose',x.purpose,
      'qty',x.qty
    ) order by x.equipment_type,x.purpose),'[]'::jsonb),
    coalesce(sum(x.qty),0)
  into v_manifest,v_count
  from (
    select equipment_type,purpose::text,count(*)::int qty
    from public.prep_items
    where prep_ticket_id=v_prep.id
    group by equipment_type,purpose::text
  ) x;

  v_work_type:=coalesce(nullif(v_prep.work_type,''),'service');

  select * into v_assignment
  from public.job_assignments
  where trim(ticket_no)=trim(p_ticket_no)
    and assigned_role=p_role
    and created_from='owner_test_center'
    and status in ('assigned','started')
  order by assigned_at desc
  limit 1
  for update;

  if found then
    update public.job_assignments
    set assignee_user_id=v_tech.user_id,
        assignee_name=coalesce(v_tech.full_name,v_tech.username,'Test Technician'),
        assignment_scope='technician',
        prep_ticket_id=v_prep.id,
        requires_it_handoff=(p_role='service'),
        equipment_manifest=v_manifest,
        requested_unit_count=v_count,
        site=v_prep.site,
        work_type=v_work_type,
        notes='OWNER TEST MODE · Disposable workflow test',
        created_from='owner_test_center',
        updated_at=now()
    where id=v_assignment.id
    returning * into v_assignment;
  else
    insert into public.job_assignments(
      ticket_no,site,assigned_role,assignee_user_id,assignee_name,notes,status,
      prep_ticket_id,assigned_by,assigned_by_name,unit_summary,job_description,
      assignment_scope,requires_it_handoff,equipment_manifest,requested_unit_count,
      scheduled_for,work_type,created_from
    ) values(
      v_prep.ticket_no,v_prep.site,p_role,v_tech.user_id,
      coalesce(v_tech.full_name,v_tech.username,'Test Technician'),
      'OWNER TEST MODE · Disposable workflow test','assigned',
      v_prep.id,auth.uid(),coalesce(v_owner.full_name,v_owner.username,'Owner'),
      'Owner Test Center equipment',
      'Disposable Owner Test Center workflow',
      'technician',(p_role='service'),v_manifest,v_count,
      timezone('America/Chicago',now())::date,v_work_type,'owner_test_center'
    )
    returning * into v_assignment;
  end if;

  insert into public.reports(kind,actor_id,actor_name,ticket_no,text,is_test)
  values(
    'OWNER TEST ROLE OPENED',
    auth.uid(),
    coalesce(v_owner.full_name,v_owner.username,'Owner'),
    v_prep.ticket_no,
    'Owner Test Mode opened the '||upper(p_role)||' workflow using test technician '||
      coalesce(v_tech.full_name,v_tech.username,'Test Technician')||'.',
    true
  );

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok',true,
    'assignment',to_jsonb(v_assignment),
    'test_tech',jsonb_build_object(
      'user_id',v_tech.user_id,
      'username',v_tech.username,
      'full_name',v_tech.full_name,
      'role',v_tech.role::text
    )
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.owner_test_set_assignment_status_v1(p_assignment_id uuid, p_status text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_owner public.profiles%rowtype;
  v_assignment public.job_assignments%rowtype;
begin
  select * into v_owner
  from public.profiles
  where user_id=auth.uid()
    and active=true
    and archived_at is null
    and role::text='owner';
  if not found then raise exception 'Owner/Admin access required.'; end if;
  if p_status not in ('started','completed','assigned') then
    raise exception 'Invalid assignment status.';
  end if;

  select a.* into v_assignment
  from public.job_assignments a
  where a.id=p_assignment_id
    and a.created_from='owner_test_center'
    and exists(
      select 1
      from public.prep_tickets p
      where trim(p.ticket_no)=trim(a.ticket_no)
        and p.is_test=true
    )
  for update;

  if not found then raise exception 'Owner Test assignment not found.'; end if;

  update public.job_assignments
  set status=p_status,
      started_at=case when p_status='started' then coalesce(started_at,now()) else started_at end,
      completed_at=case when p_status='completed' then now() when p_status<>'completed' then null else completed_at end,
      updated_at=now()
  where id=p_assignment_id;

  insert into public.reports(kind,actor_id,actor_name,ticket_no,text,is_test)
  values(
    'OWNER TEST ASSIGNMENT STATUS',
    auth.uid(),
    coalesce(v_owner.full_name,v_owner.username,'Owner'),
    v_assignment.ticket_no,
    'Owner Test Mode set '||upper(v_assignment.assigned_role)||' assignment to '||upper(p_status)||'.',
    true
  );
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.restart_service_verification_questions_v1(p_prep_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_role public.app_role;
  v_ticket text;
begin
  v_role:=public.current_app_role();
  if v_role not in ('service'::public.app_role,'owner'::public.app_role) then
    raise exception 'Service or Owner access required';
  end if;

  select ticket_no into v_ticket
  from public.prep_tickets
  where id=p_prep_id and status='released';

  if not found then
    raise exception 'Service handoff not found or no longer waiting for Service';
  end if;

  if v_role='service'::public.app_role and not exists(
    select 1
    from public.job_assignments a
    where a.assigned_role='service'
      and (a.prep_ticket_id=p_prep_id or trim(a.ticket_no)=trim(v_ticket))
      and a.assignee_user_id=auth.uid()
      and a.status in ('assigned','started','completed')
  ) then
    raise exception 'This Service handoff is not assigned to you';
  end if;

  update public.prep_items
  set service_battery_count=null,
      service_unit_confirmed=false,
      service_verified_by=null,
      service_verified_at=null
  where prep_ticket_id=p_prep_id;

  update public.prep_tickets
  set service_parts_confirmed=false,
      service_parts_confirmed_by=null,
      service_parts_confirmed_by_name=null,
      service_parts_confirmed_at=null
  where id=p_prep_id;

  update public.service_solar_checks
  set stand_verified=false,
      battery_configuration=null,
      mppt_updated_ok=false,
      mppt_tested_ok=false,
      cerbo_updated_ok=false,
      cerbo_online_ok=false,
      solar_panel_count=0,
      solar_panels_verified=false,
      battery_count=0,
      batteries_charged_ok=false,
      solar_charging_ok=false,
      helios_battery_box_charging_ok=false,
      helios_yard_pv_connected_ok=false,
      helios_yard_switch_pv_ok=false,
      helios_yard_victron_bluetooth_ok=false,
      helios_yard_updates_status_ok=false,
      helios_yard_solar_charging_ok=false,
      helios_yard_ptz_wrapped_ok=false,
      completed_at=null,
      handoff_accepted_at=null,
      handoff_accepted_by=null,

 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_status public.prep_status;
  v_type text;
  v_purpose public.prep_purpose;
  v_ready boolean;
  v_customer_specific boolean;
begin
  perform public.require_role(array['it'::public.app_role,'owner'::public.app_role]);
  select t.status,i.equipment_type,i.purpose
    into v_status,v_type,v_purpose
  from public.prep_items i
  join public.prep_tickets t on t.id=i.prep_ticket_id
  where i.id=p_item_id
  for update of i,t;
  if not found then raise exception 'Prep item not found'; end if;
  if v_status<>'draft'::public.prep_status then raise exception 'Only draft equipment prep can be edited'; end if;
  if v_type<>'Helios' or v_purpose not in ('DELIVERY'::public.prep_purpose,'SWAP'::public.prep_purpose,'BACKUP'::public.prep_purpose) then
    raise exception 'Helios deploy checks apply only to DELIVERY, SWAP, or BACKUP Helios items';
  end if;

  v_customer_specific := v_purpose in ('DELIVERY'::public.prep_purpose,'SWAP'::public.prep_purpose);

  update public.prep_items set
    helios_camera1_hardware_ok=coalesce(p_camera1_hardware_ok,false),
    helios_camera2_hardware_ok=coalesce(p_camera2_hardware_ok,false),
    helios_ptz_assembly_ok=coalesce(p_ptz_assembly_ok,false),
    helios_proxicast_4x4_ok=coalesce(p_proxicast_4x4_ok,false),
    helios_router_sim_ok=coalesce(p_router_sim_ok,false),
    helios_speaker_24v_ok=coalesce(p_speaker_24v_ok,false),
    helios_cameras_12v_ok=coalesce(p_cameras_12v_ok,false),
    helios_ptz_plate_4bolts_ok=coalesce(p_ptz_plate_4bolts_ok,false),
    helios_cerbo_network_ok=coalesce(p_cerbo_network_ok,false),
    helios_cerbo_vrm_ok=coalesce(p_cerbo_vrm_ok,false),
    helios_rear_unit_tag_ok=coalesce(p_rear_unit_tag_ok,false),
    helios_battery_box_installed_ok=coalesce(p_battery_box_installed_ok,false),
    helios_battery_120v_charged_ok=coalesce(p_battery_120v_charged_ok,false),
    helios_camera_router_programming_ok=coalesce(p_camera_router_programming_ok,false),
    helios_alibi_vigilant_ok=coalesce(p_alibi_vigilant_ok,false),
    helios_3x1tb_sd_ok=coalesce(p_3x1tb_sd_ok,false),
    helios_camera1_ports_ok=coalesce(p_camera1_ports_ok,false),
    helios_camera2_ports_ok=coalesce(p_camera2_ports_ok,false),
    helios_ptz_ports_ok=coalesce(p_ptz_ports_ok,false),
    helios_speaker_ports_ok=coalesce(p_speaker_ports_ok,false),
    delivery_sim_ok=coalesce(p_sim_ok,false),
    delivery_camera_app_ok=coalesce(p_camera_app_ok,false),
    delivery_customer_email_app_ok=case when v_customer_specific then coalesce(p_customer_email_app_ok,false) else false end,
    delivery_batteries_charged_ok=coalesce(p_battery_120v_charged_ok,false),
    delivery_monitoring_ok=case when v_customer_specific then coalesce(p_monitoring_ok,false) else false end,
    delivery_ticket_count_ok=true,
    delivery_sd_formatted_ok=coalesce(p_sd_formatted_ok,false),
    delivery_recording_ok=coalesce(p_recording_ok,false)
  where id=p_item_id;

  select
    nullif(trim(unit_tag),'') is not null
    and coalesce(power_ok,false)
    and coalesce(functions_ok,false)
    and coalesce(safe_ok,false)
    and coalesce(battery_count,0)>=greatest(1,coalesce(required_battery_count,0))
    and helios_camera1_hardware_ok and helios_camera2_hardware_ok and helios_ptz_assembly_ok
    and helios_proxicast_4x4_ok and helios_router_sim_ok and helios_speaker_24v_ok and helios_cameras_12v_ok
    and helios_ptz_plate_4bolts_ok and helios_cerbo_network_ok and helios_cerbo_vrm_ok and helios_rear_unit_tag_ok
    and helios_battery_box_installed_ok and helios_battery_120v_charged_ok and helios_camera_router_programming_ok
    and helios_alibi_vigilant_ok and helios_3x1tb_sd_ok
    and helios_camera1_ports_ok and helios_camera2_ports_ok and helios_ptz_ports_ok and helios_speaker_ports_ok
    and delivery_sim_ok and delivery_camera_app_ok and delivery_batteries_charged_ok
    and delivery_sd_formatted_ok and delivery_recording_ok
    and (not v_customer_specific or (delivery_customer_email_app_ok and delivery_monitoring_ok))
  into v_ready
  from public.prep_items where id=p_item_id;

  update public.prep_items
  set verified_by=case when v_ready then auth.uid() else null end,
      verified_at=case when v_ready then now() else null end
  where id=p_item_id;
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.save_it_helios_port_checks(p_item_id uuid, p_camera1_ports_ok boolean, p_camera2_ports_ok boolean, p_ptz_ports_ok boolean, p_speaker_ports_ok boolean)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_status public.prep_status;
  v_type text;
  v_purpose public.prep_purpose;
  v_ready boolean;
  v_deploy_ready boolean;
begin
  perform public.require_role(array['it'::public.app_role,'owner'::public.app_role]);

  select t.status, i.equipment_type, i.purpose
  into v_status, v_type, v_purpose
  from public.prep_items i
  join public.prep_tickets t on t.id = i.prep_ticket_id
  where i.id = p_item_id
  for update of i,t;

  if not found then raise exception 'Prep item not found'; end if;
  if v_status <> 'draft'::public.prep_status then
    raise exception 'Return the Service handoff to IT before editing. Completed Service verification is locked.';
  end if;
  if v_type <> 'Helios' or v_purpose not in ('DELIVERY'::public.prep_purpose,'BACKUP'::public.prep_purpose) then
    raise exception 'Helios port checks apply only to deployable DELIVERY/BACKUP Helios items';
  end if;

  update public.prep_items
  set helios_camera1_ports_ok = coalesce(p_camera1_ports_ok,false),
      helios_camera2_ports_ok = coalesce(p_camera2_ports_ok,false),
      helios_ptz_ports_ok = coalesce(p_ptz_ports_ok,false),
      helios_speaker_ports_ok = coalesce(p_speaker_ports_ok,false)
  where id = p_item_id;

  select case
    when v_purpose='DELIVERY'::public.prep_purpose then
      coalesce(delivery_sim_ok,false)
      and coalesce(delivery_camera_app_ok,false)
      and coalesce(delivery_customer_email_app_ok,false)
      and coalesce(delivery_batteries_charged_ok,false)
      and coalesce(delivery_monitoring_ok,false)
      and coalesce(delivery_ticket_count_ok,false)
      and coalesce(delivery_sd_formatted_ok,false)
      and coalesce(delivery_recording_ok,false)
    else
      coalesce(delivery_sim_ok,false)
      and coalesce(delivery_camera_app_ok,false)
      and coalesce(delivery_batteries_charged_ok,false)
      and coalesce(delivery_sd_formatted_ok,false)
      and coalesce(delivery_recording_ok,false)
  end
  into v_deploy_ready
  from public.prep_items
  where id=p_item_id;

  select
    nullif(trim(unit_tag),'') is not null
    and coalesce(power_ok,false)
    and coalesce(functions_ok,false)
    and coalesce(safe_ok,false)
    and coalesce(battery_count,0) >= coalesce(required_battery_count,0)
    and v_deploy_ready
    and coalesce(helios_camera1_ports_ok,false)
    and coalesce(helios_camera2_ports_ok,false)
    and coalesce(helios_ptz_ports_ok,false)
    and coalesce(helios_speaker_ports_ok,false)
  into v_ready
  from public.prep_items
  where id = p_item_id;

  update public.prep_items
  set verified_by = case when v_ready then auth.uid() else null end,
      verified_at = case when v_ready then now() else null end
  where id = p_item_id;
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.save_my_service_solar_check(p_prep_id uuid, p_stand_tag text, p_stand_verified boolean, p_mppt_updated_ok boolean, p_mppt_tested_ok boolean, p_cerbo_updated_ok boolean, p_cerbo_online_ok boolean, p_solar_panel_count integer, p_solar_panels_verified boolean, p_battery_count integer, p_batteries_charged_ok boolean, p_solar_charging_ok boolean)
 RETURNS service_solar_checks
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_role public.app_role;
  v_name text;
  v_status public.prep_status;
  v_need_solar boolean;
  v_need_stand boolean;
  v_has_helios boolean;
  v_assignment uuid;
  v_complete boolean;
  v_was_complete boolean := false;
  v_row public.service_solar_checks%rowtype;
begin
  v_role := public.current_app_role();
  if v_role not in ('service'::public.app_role,'owner'::public.app_role) then
    raise exception 'Service or Owner access required';
  end if;

  select status into v_status
  from public.prep_tickets
  where id=p_prep_id;
  if not found then raise exception 'Equipment prep not found'; end if;
  if v_status<>'released'::public.prep_status then
    raise exception 'Solar / Helios verification is only available while equipment is waiting for Service';
  end if;

  select c.need_solar,c.need_stand,c.has_helios,c.assignment_id
  into v_need_solar,v_need_stand,v_has_helios,v_assignment
  from public.service_solar_context(p_prep_id) c;

  if not coalesce(v_need_solar,false) then
    raise exception 'This ticket does not require a Solar Stand / Helios Service verification';
  end if;

  if coalesce(p_solar_panel_count,0)<0 or coalesce(p_battery_count,0)<0 then
    raise exception 'Counts cannot be negative';
  end if;

  select completed_at is not null into v_was_complete
  from public.service_solar_checks
  where prep_ticket_id=p_prep_id;

  v_complete :=
    (not v_need_stand or (
      nullif(trim(coalesce(p_stand_tag,'')),'') is not null
      and coalesce(p_stand_verified,false)
    ))
    and coalesce(p_mppt_updated_ok,false)
    and coalesce(p_mppt_tested_ok,false)
    and (not v_has_helios or (
      coalesce(p_cerbo_updated_ok,false)
      and coalesce(p_cerbo_online_ok,false)
    ))
    and coalesce(p_solar_panel_count,0)>0
    and coalesce(p_solar_panels_verified,false)
    and coalesce(p_battery_count,0)>0
    and coalesce(p_batteries_charged_ok,false)
    and coalesce(p_solar_charging_ok,false);

  v_name := public.actor_display_name();

  insert into public.service_solar_checks(
    prep_ticket_id,assignment_id,service_tech_id,service_tech_name,
    stand_tag,stand_verified,mppt_updated_ok,mppt_tested_ok,
    cerbo_updated_ok,cerbo_online_ok,solar_panel_count,solar_panels_verified,
    battery_count,batteries_charged_ok,solar_charging_ok,completed_at,updated_at
  )
  values(
    p_prep_id,v_assignment,auth.uid(),v_name,
    nullif(trim(coalesce(p_stand_tag,'')),''),
    coalesce(p_stand_verified,false),
    coalesce(p_mppt_updated_ok,false),
    coalesce(p_mppt_tested_ok,false),
    case when v_has_helios then coalesce(p_cerbo_updated_ok,false) else null end,
    case when v_has_helios then coalesce(p_cerbo_online_ok,false) else null end,
    coalesce(p_solar_panel_count,0),
    coalesce(p_solar_panels_verified,false),
    coalesce(p_battery_count,0),
    coalesce(p_batteries_charged_ok,false),
    coalesce(p_solar_charging_ok,false),
    case when v_complete then now() else null end,
    now()
  )
  on conflict(prep_ticket_id) do update set
    assignment_id=excluded.assignment_id,
    service_tech_id=auth.uid(),
    service_tech_name=v_name,
    stand_tag=excluded.stand_tag,
    stand_verified=excluded.stand_verified,
    mppt_updated_ok=excluded.mppt_updated_ok,
    mppt_tested_ok=excluded.mppt_tested_ok,
    cerbo_updated_ok=excluded.cerbo_updated_ok,
    cerbo_online_ok=excluded.cerbo_online_ok,
    solar_panel_count=excluded.solar_panel_count,
    solar_panels_verified=excluded.solar_panels_verified,
    battery_count=excluded.battery_count,
    batteries_charged_ok=excluded.batteries_charged_ok,
    solar_charging_ok=excluded.solar_charging_ok,
    completed_at=excluded.completed_at,
    updated_at=now()
  returning * into v_row;

  if v_complete and not coalesce(v_was_complete,false) then
    insert into public.reports(kind,actor_id,actor_name,ticket_no,text)
    select
      'SERVICE SOLAR / HELIOS CHECK COMPLETE',
      auth.uid(),
      v_name,
      p.ticket_no,
      'Service Tech '||v_name||
      ' verified '||
      case when v_need_stand then 'Solar Stand '||coalesce(v_row.stand_tag,'')||', ' else '' end||
      'MPPT updated/tested, '||
      case when v_has_helios then 'Cerbo updated/online, ' else '' end||
      v_row.solar_panel_count||' solar panel'||case when v_row.solar_panel_count=1 then '' else 's' end||', '||
      v_row.battery_count||' batter'||case when v_row.battery_count=1 then 'y' else 'ies' end||
      ', batteries charged, and solar/MPPT charging confirmed.'
    from public.prep_tickets p
    where p.id=p_prep_id;
  end if;

  return v_row;
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_unit_registry_from_prep_ticket()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_status text;
  v_event text;
begin
  if new.status is not distinct from old.status then return new; end if;

  v_status := case new.status::text
    when 'draft' then 'it_prep'
    when 'released' then 'ready_for_service'
    else 'deployed'
  end;
  v_event := case v_status
    when 'it_prep' then 'IT prep active'
    when 'ready_for_service' then 'IT released to Service'
    else 'Service deployed to field'
  end;

  update public.unit_registry
  set lifecycle_status=v_status,
      ticket_no=new.ticket_no,
      current_holder_id=case when v_status='deployed' then new.closed_by else null end,
      current_holder_name=case when v_status='deployed' then new.closed_by_name else null end,
      last_event=v_event,
      updated_at=now()
  where prep_ticket_id=new.id
    and lifecycle_status in ('it_prep','ready_for_service','deployed');

  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_unit_registry_from_return()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_key text;
  v_prev record;
  v_status text;
begin
  if tg_op='DELETE' then
    v_key := public.normalize_unit_key(old.unit_tag);
    if v_key='' then return old; end if;

    select i.id as prep_item_id,i.prep_ticket_id,i.unit_tag,i.equipment_type,
           t.ticket_no,t.status,t.closed_by,t.closed_by_name
    into v_prev
    from public.prep_items i
    join public.prep_tickets t on t.id=i.prep_ticket_id
    where public.normalize_unit_key(i.unit_tag)=v_key
    order by t.created_at desc,i.item_order desc
    limit 1;

    if found then
      v_status := case v_prev.status::text
        when 'draft' then 'it_prep'
        when 'released' then 'ready_for_service'
        else 'deployed'
      end;

      insert into public.unit_registry(
        unit_key,unit_tag,equipment_type,lifecycle_status,ticket_no,
        prep_ticket_id,prep_item_id,current_holder_id,current_holder_name,last_event,updated_at
      )
      values(
        v_key,v_prev.unit_tag,v_prev.equipment_type,v_status,v_prev.ticket_no,
        v_prev.prep_ticket_id,v_prev.prep_item_id,
        case when v_status='deployed' then v_prev.closed_by else null end,
        case when v_status='deployed' then v_prev.closed_by_name else null end,
        'Return tracking removed by Owner',now()
      )
      on conflict(unit_key) do update set
        unit_tag=excluded.unit_tag,
        equipment_type=excluded.equipment_type,
        lifecycle_status=excluded.lifecycle_status,
        ticket_no=excluded.ticket_no,
        prep_ticket_id=excluded.prep_ticket_id,
        prep_item_id=excluded.prep_item_id,
        current_holder_id=excluded.current_holder_id,
        current_holder_name=excluded.current_holder_name,
        last_event=excluded.last_event,
        updated_at=now();
    else
      delete from public.unit_registry
      where unit_key=v_key
        and lifecycle_status in ('returned_waiting_it','waiting_manager','maintenance');
    end if;

    return old;
  end if;

  v_key := public.normalize_unit_key(new.unit_tag);
  if v_key='' then return new; end if;

  v_status := case new.status
    when 'waiting_it' then 'returned_waiting_it'
    when 'pending_mhelp_inventory' then 'waiting_manager'
    when 'needs_replacement' then 'maintenance'
    else 'shop_inventory'
  end;

  insert into public.unit_registry(
    unit_key,unit_tag,equipment_type,lifecycle_status,ticket_no,
    prep_ticket_id,prep_item_id,current_holder_id,current_holder_name,
    current_site,site_registered_at,site_registered_by,site_registered_by_name,
    last_event,updated_at
  )
  values(
    v_key,btrim(new.unit_tag),new.equipment_type,v_status,new.ticket_no,
    new.prep_ticket_id,new.prep_item_id,
    case
      when v_status='returned_waiting_it' then new.service_tech_id
      when v_status='waiting_manager' then new.it_tech_id
      else null
    end,
    case
      when v_status='returned_waiting_it' then new.service_tech_name
      when v_status='waiting_manager' then new.it_tech_name
      else null
    end,
    null,null,null,null,
    case v_status
      when 'returned_waiting_it' then 'Returned by Service — waiting IT intake'
      when 'waiting_manager' then 'IT intake complete — waiting Manager/MHelpDesk'
      when 'maintenance' then 'Damage confirmed — replacement/repair required — Owner notified'
      else 'Back in Shop Inventory'
    end,
    now()
  )
  on conflict(unit_key) do update set
    unit_tag=excluded.unit_tag,
    equipment_type=coalesce(excluded.equipment_type,public.unit_registry.equipment_type),
    lifecycle_status=excluded.lifecycle_status,
    ticket_no=excluded.ticket_no,
    prep_ticket_id=coalesce(excluded.prep_ticket_id,public.unit_registry.prep_ticket_id),
    prep_item_id=coalesce(excluded.prep_item_id,public.unit_registry.prep_item_id),
    current_holder_id=excluded.current_holder_id,
    current_holder_name=excluded.current_holder_name,
    current_site=null,
    site_registered_at=null,
    site_registered_by=null,
    site_registered_by_name=null,
    last_event=excluded.last_event,
    updated_at=now();

  return new;
end;
$function$
